One five-second Git rev-parse timeout caused safe source identity refusal; no new runtime built.

mechanism: Replace two per-file Git processes with ordered size/type/OID precheck and raw-blob batches. Only selected immutable OIDs requested. Keep exact HEAD/population/index/worktree/byte/size/isolation guards and five-second percall ceiling.

probe.interpretation: Source-builder efficiency only. Sequential samples under changing host load; timing is descriptive, not a general speedup or routing claim.

adversarial.resolution: Metadata batch must exactly match expected sizes/types/OIDs before content request; hidden oversized HEAD blob is rejected without reading its body.
controls: Oversized committed blob hidden by assume-unchanged

decision: Integrate bounded source/build efficiency change; do not claim it eliminates host resource failures. Fresh full suite and one fresh runtime069 build/install/Native/GUI/large600qualification required. No routing gain/B1B2 superiority.
